demo.title: blossom-check.sh
demo.code:
# BNB Chain safety verdict (no auth required)
curl -s 'https://blossomtrade.dev/api/bsc-safety?token=0x0e09fabb73bd3ade0a17ecc321fd13a19e81ce82' | jq '{verdict, risk, headline}'

# Robinhood Chain or Arc drain check
curl -s 'https://blossomtrade.dev/api/evm-safety?chain=robinhood&token=<0x contract>' | jq '{verdict, headline}'

# Agent flow
bankr prompt "Using the blossom-token-check skill, check 0x0e09fabb73bd3ade0a17ecc321fd13a19e81ce82 on BNB Chain"

setup: No API key or wallet required: every endpoint is public, keyless and read-only (GET)
BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain (chain ID `4663`) and Arc (chain ID `5042`) take a 0x contract address; the Solana record takes a mint
